quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on Clippers' early game turnover struggles
quotes.excerpt: we had four turnovers in the first four minutes. Just some things we got to clean up.
quotes.quote: I think it was kind of deflating early on. We had four turnovers in the first four minutes. Just some things we got to clean up. They got to understand that just making a simple play, sometimes you are going to have bad breaks, but we had a lot of unforced turnovers that we can take care of and have control over.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue says the Clippers' early game struggles were deflating, noting they had four turnovers in the first four minutes. He emphasized they have to clean up the unforced errors to take control of games.

structured.context: Tyronn Lue discusses the team's early game struggles with unforced turnovers during a postgame press conference.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on creating offense without primary shot creators
quotes.excerpt: up tempo, and when we get stops, get out in transition, run, advance, attack early.
quotes.quote: It is the way we got to play. Up tempo, and when we get stops, get out in transition, run, advance, attack early. But in a half court, we got to play just as fast. Because we are limited offensively, and so when we get in the half court, as much as we talk about running in transition, you got to sprint in the screens, you got to sprint to cuts, you got to do all the different things hard and with pace.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue on the Clippers' offensive identity: We are limited offensively, so we have to play fast. Even in the half court, you have to sprint into screens and cuts to play with pace.

structured.context: Tyronn Lue explains the need for the team to play with pace and intensity in both transition and half-court sets due to offensive limitations.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on Kobe Brown's defensive positioning
quotes.excerpt: he does a good job of standing in front of the basketball. He is not getting blown by.
quotes.quote: He will be okay. He does a good job of standing in front of the basketball. He is not getting blown by, so that is a good thing right there. Just at the rim, sometimes when guys are trying to bully him at the rim, with the physicality, just understanding how to guard and how to wall up and things like that, which he will get better at.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue on Kobe Brown's defense: He does a good job of standing in front of the basketball and not getting blown by. He just needs to improve his physicality at the rim when guys try to bully him.

structured.context: Tyronn Lue evaluates Kobe Brown's defensive performance, noting his ability to stay in front of players while highlighting the need for better rim physicality.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on Darius Garland's offensive role and pressure
quotes.excerpt: he just cannot feel the pressure of having to do it every single time.
quotes.quote: Just relying on him to make plays, coming down the floor, and being able to score the basketball as well as getting guys involved. We are asking a lot of him with guys being out. He just cannot feel the pressure of having to do it every single time. structured.context: Tyronn Lue discusses the offensive burden placed on Darius Garland and the defensive attention he faces from opposing teams.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on Darius Garland's ability to draw fouls
quotes.excerpt: he gets to the free throw line and can shoot the basketball.
quotes.quote: It is important. I just got to sit down with him and just show him film one-on-one and just talk through different plays and situations. So just seeing it, being able to look at it, and then understanding next game of how teams are going to play you and how to attack.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on the importance of secondary ball-handling
quotes.excerpt: keep Kobe in with the second lineup, so he can do more of the ball handling.
quotes.quote: That is why it is important to keep Kobe in with the second lineup, so he can do more of the ball handling and Kobe is off the ball, which will help him out a lot. quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue explains the importance of keeping Kobe Brown in the second unit to handle the ball, noting that when rotations get tricky and Brown is off the floor, the team struggles against pressure.

structured.context: Tyronn Lue explains the importance of managing rotations to ensure Kobe Brown and Darius Garland are positioned effectively to handle ball-pressure.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue on Darius Garland's injury status
quotes.excerpt: he is playing through a little something, but he is okay to play.
quotes.quote: He is playing through a little something, but he is okay to play. He is playing through a little something, which is taking his pop away a little bit, but overall he is good. quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue confirms Darius Garland is playing through a minor injury. He says it is taking his pop away a little bit, but he is okay to play as the primary ball handler.

quotes.speaker: Kobe Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Kobe Brown on the value of drawing fouls
quotes.excerpt: especially in these type of games, when they are pressing a lot and you got to get downhill.
quotes.quote: It is a great skill to have, especially in these type of games, when they are pressing a lot and you got to get downhill in the paint and just being able to stay in control and stride stop and play off two, all those different things is a good skill to have to get fouled and get to the line.
quotes.social_post: Kobe Brown on his ability to draw fouls: It is a great skill to have, especially in these types of games when they are pressing a lot and you have to get downhill in the paint and stay in control.

structured.context: Kobe Brown discusses the importance of being able to draw fouls and stay in control when facing high-pressure defense.

quotes.speaker: Kobe Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Kobe Brown on his relationship with Tyronn Lue
quotes.excerpt: when I am working out before practice, he is usually watching me.
quotes.quote: We built a great relationship. I got to make sure to create separation versus letting the defender stay on me, so that is one thing I have been trying to work on a lot just to be able to handle the pressure throughout the whole game.
quotes.social_post: Kobe Brown says he has built a great relationship with Tyronn Lue, who works with him before practice on ball handling and creating separation coming off screens.

structured.context: Kobe Brown describes his working relationship with Tyronn Lue and the specific skills they are focusing on during practice.

quotes.speaker: Kobe Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Kobe Brown on responding to physical defense
quotes.excerpt: talking to Coach Lue, he is saying like if they are doing that, just go by them.
quotes.quote: Talking to Coach Lue, he is saying like if they are doing that, just go by them and that is kind of what I tried to do tonight was just get by my defender and I think I did it pretty well, got to the line multiple times from doing that. So just continuing to read the game that way, if they are trying to be physical, go by them.
quotes.social_post: Kobe Brown says Coach Lue's advice against physical defense is simple: If they are playing you physically, just go by them. Brown says he tried to do that tonight to get to the line.

quotes.speaker: Kobe Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Kobe Brown on improving his post defense
quotes.excerpt: I think I definitely got to get better at that. Tonight was not my best defensive night.
quotes.quote: I think I definitely got to get better at that. Tonight was not my best defensive night and I am just kind of frustrated with myself for that, letting the guards kind of get downhill and get in my body and then not being as physical with them back and then fouling too much. So just got to learn from that, watch film, but post defense, it is kind of really just about holding my ground and making them make a tough shot over me.
quotes.social_post: Kobe Brown was frustrated with his defensive performance tonight. He says he needs to get better at post defense and holding his ground instead of letting guards get into his body and fouling.

quotes.speaker: Darius Garland

quotes.speaker: Darius Garland
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Garland on team chemistry and turnovers

quotes.speaker: Darius Garland
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Garland on team ball movement and execution

quotes.speaker: Darius Garland
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Garland on responding to runs as a group

I mean, basketball is a game of runs, there is so many games, you know, teams are going to, they are going to hit shots one night and, you know, we can't let that, you know, kind of demoralize us as a group.

quotes.speaker: Darius Garland
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Garland on Kobe Brown's development
